method.primary: LOO+flip self-training R0→R1→R2, independent model per externally supplied pallet type
method.ablation: LOO-only self-training with use_flip=False; LOO/filter/trainer/seed/budget otherwise fixed

method.registered_geometry: C2 camera-facing cuboid; registry-fixed rectangular W/D hypotheses; no continuous dimension adaptation, GT branch, or per-frame GT points/pose.
method.trusted_target: Raw teacher native-image coordinates; RANSAC/held-out LOO/flip support; >=6 trusted corners; centroid8 ignored for real loss.
method.losses: Six-stage synthetic masked belief+affinity MSE and real trusted-belief MSE; effective-batch valid-channel-pixel means; lambda_real1.

metric_contract.metric: Semantic same-index cuboid corners0..7; native image pixels; reference visibility>0 and explicit in_frame plus image bounds.
metric_contract.PCK: Fraction of ALL eligible reference points with Euclidean error <=5/10/20 pixels. Missing predictions count as failures.
metric_contract.coverage: Observed prediction count / all eligible reference points.
metric_contract.conditional_median: Median error among observed reference predictions only; differs in denominator from PCK.
limitations: Repeated DEV data, one optimizer seed, descriptive results; no independent TEST or physical6D accuracy claim.
GREEN manual-only means the recorded manual_click source. Independent point verification is not established.
WOOD training sources REC001/002 share recordings with protected physical FINAL. Exact protected229 images are excluded, but recording-independent FINAL claims are relinquished.
PLASTIC184 is separate evaluation-only scope: core128 reused plus56 FINAL-role frames. It does not replace the core128 comparison.
Source-provided camera K is not independently calibrated/verified.
Real pseudo acceptance differs across methods; common optimizer/synthetic budgets do not equate real support.
All fixed R1/R2 checkpoints and source-only controls are reported; no requirement that self-training beats every control is imposed.
